'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matt Sokol LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
